???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "In which style of IR is every named value assigned exactly once, so that a changing variable becomes a series of versions?"

        Static single assignment (SSA) form.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "Which term does the specification use for this idea: the part of a program during which a reference made by & or &mut is live: to the end of the enclosing...?"

        Borrow. The part of a program during which a reference made by & or &mut is live: to the end of the enclosing block for a let binding, or for the whole call for an argument. See References and mutability 9.8.

        Introduced in [Specification: 9. References and mutability](../specification/references.md).

    ??? question "How can a function read or change an existing value without copying it, and how are the two kinds written?"

        Through a reference. `&T` is a shared reference for reading; `&mut T` is a mutable reference that can also change the value.

        Introduced in [Learn: 4. Variables and types](../language-tour/04-variables-and-types.md). Specification: [9. References and mutability](../specification/references.md#91-reference-types).
